    testTypes(
        "/** @constructor */ function Foo(){}" +
        "/**\n" +

        "Foo.prototype.add = function(one, two) {};" +
        "/**\n" +
        " * @constructor\n" +

        "function Bar(){}" +
        "/** @override */\n" +
        "Bar.prototype.add = function(ignored) {};" +

        "required: string");
